# netactuate_router_static_route (Resource)

Beta. The cloud router family is in beta: behaviour and schema may change. Manages a static route in a cloud router VRF.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_router_static_route" "example" {
  network   = "192.0.2.0/24"
  router_id = 12345
  vrf_id    = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network` (String) The network to route traffic towards (CIDR notation, e.g. 10.0.0.0/24).
- `router_id` (Number) The ID of the cloud router.
- `vrf_id` (Number) The ID of the VRF.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description for the static route.
- `distance` (Number) An optional administrative distance for the route (1-255).
- `interface_id` (Number) The ID of the interface to route traffic to.
- `ipsec_peer_id` (Number) The ID of the IPSec peer to route traffic to.
- `next_hop` (String) The next-hop IP address to route traffic to (IPv4 or IPv6).
- `tunnel_id` (Number) The ID of the tunnel to route traffic to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `route_id` (Number) The ID of the static route.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_router_static_route.example 12345
```
